title: Semio Js Entity Class Refactor
description: Refactor semio/client/lib/js to only have one class per entity with exactly one method per field, one method for command, and one method for events for every field change. Align with semio/rs and graphql schema. Update downstream semio/react and tests.
summary: Completed full semio/js entity refactor. Kit entities use installEntityKitMethods; node entities use installEntityNodeMethods; VCS entities use installEntityStoreBranchMethods and installEntityScopedNodeMethods (Graph, Alternative, TheKit, Checkpoint, Change, Edit, Conflict). Weak geometry (Coordinate, Point, Vector) use installWeakKitFieldMethods with on*Changed. Removed legacy subscribe* collection helpers. Fixed wasm dispatch_wip_wait using instant crate. tsc --noEmit and 5/5 vitest tests pass.
